description: Whether an exact subject meets a fixed set of checks it didn't choose, each check answered, with the evidence the evaluator obtained itself.

assessments.description: One answer per check. Every answer stays visible, even when one failure already decides the whole.

criteria_set.description: Which runx.criteria.v1 set it answered, by its revision digest.

evaluator.description: Who judged. The runtime sets it from the step that returned the verdict, never the step.

subject.description: What was judged. The verdict counts only for this exact revision.

verdict.description: The whole: any required criterion not_met makes it not_met; otherwise any missing or unresolved one makes it inconclusive; only every required one met makes it met.

title: Verdict
